character: Typical village atmosphere, renovated farms, chalets and residences, welcoming holiday experience

non_ski_activities.domain_wide: 310km, 6 resorts. Activities across all: snowshoeing, paragliding, dog sledding, snowmobiling, snakegliss, swimming pools, spas, saunas, massage. Savoyard dining (raclette, fondue, tartiflette). Local produce shops. Guided snowmobile tours from La Toussuire, Le Corbier, St-Sorlin.
